record.paper_title: Open Problems on Eigenvalues of the Laplacian
record.original_question: Let Ω be a bounded domain in ℝⁿ with n ≥ 2. For the buckling problem Δ²v = −ΛΔv in Ω with v = 0 and ∂v/∂n = 0 on ∂Ω, must the lowest buckling eigenvalue Λ₁ satisfy the Faber-Krahn-type inequality |Ω|^{2/n} Λ₁ ≥ (|Ω|^{2/n} Λ₁)_{n-ball}?

evidence.quote: For Ω ⊂ ℝⁿ with n ≥ 2 prove that the lowest eigenvalue Λ₁ of (41)-(42) satisfies |Ω|^{2/n} Λ₁ ≥ (|Ω|^{2/n} Λ₁)|n-ball.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\Omega \subset \mathbb{R}^n$, $n \geq 2$, be a bounded domain with smooth boundary, and let $\nu$ denote the outward unit normal to $\partial\Omega$. Consider the buckling eigenvalue problem
$$\Delta^2 v = -\Lambda \Delta v \quad \text{in } \Omega, \qquad v = 0 \text{ and } \frac{\partial v}{\partial \nu} = 0 \text{ on } \partial\Omega,$$
and let $\Lambda_1(\Omega)$ denote its lowest eigenvalue (equivalently, the smallest $\Lambda$ for which a nontrivial $v \in H_0^2(\Omega)$ exists). Let $B \subset \mathbb{R}^n$ be a ball, and let $|\cdot|$ denote $n$-dimensional Lebesgue measure. Prove or disprove that
$$|\Omega|^{2/n}\, \Lambda_1(\Omega) \;\geq\; |B|^{2/n}\, \Lambda_1(B),$$
with equality if and only if $\Omega$ is a ball (up to a set of measure zero).
artifact.status_search_result: The Faber-Krahn-type inequality for the first buckling eigenvalue (the Pólya–Szegő buckling conjecture, ca. 1950) remains open in general dimension. Partial results exist (e.g., Ashbaugh–Bucur and others establish that the ball is at least a local minimizer and prove related bounds), but the full conjecture for arbitrary bounded domains in $\mathbb{R}^n$, $n\geq 2$, has not been established.

status_evidence.title: Inequalities for the first eigenvalues of the clamped plate and buckling problems
status_evidence.snippet: Analogous conjecture concerning the critical buckling load of a clamped plate was made by Pólya and Szegő around 1950, and this conjecture remains open.
status_evidence.claim: The Pólya–Szegő conjecture for the buckling eigenvalue is still open.

status_evidence.title: Open Problems on Eigenvalues of the Laplacian
status_evidence.snippet: For Ω ⊂ ℝⁿ with n ≥ 2 prove that the lowest eigenvalue Λ₁ satisfies |Ω|^{2/n} Λ₁ ≥ (|Ω|^{2/n} Λ₁)|n-ball.
status_evidence.claim: The inequality is posed as an open problem.
